description_html:
Key Features

  • Aufeis-Jacketed Cheese Vault: Advanced thermal insulation technology maintains stable storage conditions, ideal for preserving cheese quality.
  • Chamber Depth: 22 Metres: Deep storage chamber maximizes protection from external temperature fluctuations and ensures consistent aging.
  • Holding Temperature: -1°C: Precisely controlled environment prevents spoilage and extends shelf life for a wide range of cheese varieties.
  • Unit Capacity: 1,172 Units: High-capacity vault accommodates large inventories, making it suitable for commercial cheese storage needs.
  • Retrieval Time: 32 Minutes: Efficient retrieval system allows for timely access to stored products, supporting smooth inventory management.
  • Annual Fee: Pricing is determined post-acceptance, offering flexibility based on specific storage requirements.
  • Open Months: 2 Months: Vault is available for storage during a dedicated 2-month period, ideal for seasonal or limited-time storage needs.

Main Benefits

  • Optimal Cheese Preservation: Maintains ideal humidity and temperature, reducing spoilage and ensuring cheeses mature properly.
  • High Storage Efficiency: Large capacity supports bulk storage, reducing the need for multiple storage solutions.
  • Reliable Access: Predictable retrieval time streamlines logistics for cheese producers, distributors, and retailers.
  • Customizable Storage Terms: Flexible fee structure accommodates different business sizes and storage durations.
  • Seasonal Storage Solution: Short-term availability is perfect for producers with peak production periods or special releases.

Typical Use Cases or Outcomes

  • Commercial Cheese Producers: Safely store large cheese batches during peak production months with confidence in quality preservation.
  • Distributors & Retailers: Manage inventory efficiently with reliable access and stable storage conditions.
  • Artisan Cheesemakers: Utilize controlled environments for specialty or limited-edition cheese aging and storage.
  • Event Planners & Caterers: Secure short-term storage for cheese selections needed for festivals, markets, or seasonal events.

Frequently Asked Questions

  • Is the vault suitable for long-term cheese aging?
    The controlled -1°C environment is designed for short- to medium-term storage, ideal for maintaining freshness and quality.
  • How do I know if my cheese inventory will fit?
    The vault holds up to 1,172 units, accommodating a wide range of inventory sizes.
  • What are the terms for storage fees?
    Annual fees are set individually after acceptance, ensuring pricing aligns with your specific storage needs.
  • How quickly can I access my cheese?
    Standard retrieval time is 32 minutes, supporting efficient operations.
